description: Get a page's metadata: title, description, canonical URL, language, Open Graph and Twitter card (including preview image), icons, RSS feeds, JSON-LD types, H1s, link and word counts. Fast (under 2 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call, with card credits (access_key) or x402.

access_key.description: Prepaid credit key (cs_live_...) bought by card at https://www.aypiai.online/credits. Works on every tool; each call deducts its price.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: meta
title: Get a page's metadata
